simple.meaning: גָּנַן (gânan) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to hedge about, i.e. (generally) protect.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 8 times in 2 Kings, Isaiah, Zechariah, beginning at 2 Kings 19:34. The surrounding contexts include kingship, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גָּנַן (H1598) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: גָּנַן (gânan) / H1598 is traced through 2 Kings 19:34, 2 Kings 20:6, Isaiah 31:5, Isaiah 37:35 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H1598. ganan [ גָּנַן ] verb cover, surround, defend (Arabic , Aramaic אַגֵּן (Aph`el), Palmyrene אגן Vog Palm.132 ff. ) — Qal Perfect וְגַנּוֺתִי Isa 37:35 3 t.; Infinitive absolute גָּנוֺן 31:5 (c. Hiph`il q. v.) — defend , subject always ׳י ; object the city Jerusalem with על 37:35 ; 38:6 = 2Kin 20:6 ; 19:34 with אֶלֿ (|| הוֺשִׁיעַ ). Hiph`il Imperfect — or Qal according to Ba ZMG 1889, 178 , who compare Arabic — יָגֵן Isa 31:5 2 t. — defend (= Qal), Jerusalem 31:5 גָּ֗֗֗נוֺן יגן with על (|| הִצִּיל ); object Yahweh's people Zech 9:15 with על , 12:8 with בְּעַד .
